tokenlogin.title: Token Accounts
tokenlogin.settings.title: Settings
tokenlogin.settings.position.note: Choose "None" to hide the button on the multiplayer screen. You can still open the account manager from this settings screen.
tokenlogin.empty: No accounts yet. Click "Add Account" to import a refresh token.
tokenlogin.status.logged_in: Logged in as %s. Reconnect to the server to apply it.
tokenlogin.status.refresh_ok: Access Token for %s refreshed, expires in %s
tokenlogin.status.refresh_invalid: Refresh Token for %s is invalid, please re-import it
tokenlogin.import.title: Import Refresh Token
tokenlogin.import.hint: Paste a refresh token, or a whole JSON / launcher account file that contains one. Characters such as ! and * inside the token are kept intact.
tokenlogin.error.no_token: No refresh token found in the pasted text
tokenlogin.error.invalid_refresh: The refresh token is invalid or has expired
tokenlogin.error.invalid_refresh_detail: The refresh token is invalid or has expired (%s)
tokenlogin.error.network: Network error, please try again later
tokenlogin.error.http: The auth server returned an error: %s
tokenlogin.error.xbox: Xbox authentication failed, please check the account
tokenlogin.error.xbox_no_account: This Microsoft account has no Xbox account yet. Sign in to Xbox once first.
tokenlogin.error.xbox_region: Xbox Live is not available in this account's region
tokenlogin.error.xbox_child: This is a child account and needs family approval
tokenlogin.error.no_minecraft: This account does not own Minecraft: Java Edition
tokenlogin.settings.hotkey_hint: Hotkey: bind "Open Token accounts" under Options - Controls - Key Binds - Multiplayer; works even when the multiplayer button is set to None.
tokenlogin.settings.auto_refresh.note: When on, the access token is renewed with the refresh token once it has less than 10 minutes left. When off, use the "Refresh" button next to the account.
tokenlogin.account.at_invalid: Access Token unavailable (refresh token is invalid)
